summary.prose: Build the sweep-hang fix in four small tasks: keep the exec-stand-in test server ref'd while installed (drops server.unref()), give bare test sweeps a finite default per-test timeout via a package.json sweep script documented in docs/testing.md, smoke-verify the repro sweep terminates on every run, and regression-check that the harness gate path is unchanged.

tasks.title: Drop server.unref() in the exec-stand-in test helper
tasks.summary: src/workflow/__tests__/helpers/exec-stand-in.ts: keep the gh/git stand-in Unix-socket server ref'd while installed (remove server.unref()), so an awaited execFile response keeps the event loop alive; remove() still closes the server and restores PATH. Add a unit assertion that the server handle is ref'd while installed.
acceptanceChecks: installExecStandIn leaves the stand-in server ref'd until remove()
an awaited gh/git call through the stand-in resolves
remove() closes the server and restores PATH

tests.name: exec-stand-in keeps its server ref'd while installed

tasks.title: Give the bare sweep a finite default per-test timeout
tasks.summary: Add an npm script (e.g. "test:sweep") that runs tsx --test with a finite --test-timeout so bare parallel globs always bound each file, and document it in docs/testing.md: bare globs should use the bounded invocation; the harness remains the owned gate path.
acceptanceChecks: package.json has the sweep script with a finite --test-timeout
docs/testing.md documents the bounded bare invocation

tests.name: bare sweep with the default timeout terminates and reports every file

tasks.title: Smoke-verify the repro sweep terminates on every run
tasks.summary: Run the bare workflow+mcp sweep repeatedly on Node 22.22.1 with the new default: every attempt finishes within the bound and every file reports a result (previously 6/6 hangs at 100s without a timeout).
acceptanceChecks: N consecutive bare sweeps finish without an external kill and report all files

tests.name: repro sweep finishes within the bound on every attempt

tasks.title: Regression: harness gate path unchanged
tasks.summary: Run npm test -- on the touched helper's test file and the gate-pinned single-file runs to prove the harness path (bounded child, --test-force-exit) is unaffected; root typecheck clean.
acceptanceChecks: npm test -- <exec-stand-in usage file> passes under the pinned Node 22.22.1 command

tests.name: harness run of the touched helper file passes

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: bare tsx --test --test-timeout=<default> glob runs of src/workflow + src/mcp
repeated bare sweeps of the workflow+mcp subsets on Node 22.22.1

epicImpact.findings: Two compounding mechanisms: unref'd test-awaited handles can drain the loop; no per-test timeout on bare runs.
